For your 30-minute commute, given your interest in true crime and unsolved cases, I recommend the podcast "Unsolved" hosted by Matt and Emma Willis. It is perfect for short commutes as episodes are typically around 30-45 minutes, focusing specifically on mysterious and unsolved crimes with a mix of storytelling and detective work. Another great option is "Casefile True Crime," which offers concise, well-researched episodes that often fit within a 30-minute window, allowing you to dive deep into the investigative process without feeling rushed.
